[EN] It's good to see the Gutrends put in their place like that. Sooner or later, maybe they'll finally just get out and give us our peace.

Still, though, we're making excellent progress. Crevan at Vindicator Camp will want to know about this.

Since you're responsible for so much of our success, why don't you bring him the message yourself?
[ES] Es bueno ver a los Gutrends en su lugar de esa manera. Tarde o temprano, tal vez finalmente se larguen y nos den paz.

Aun así, estamos logrando un progreso excelente. Crevan en Vindicator Camp querrá saber sobre esto.

Ya que eres responsable de gran parte de nuestro éxito, ¿por qué no le llevas el mensaje tú mismo?

[EN] You've knocked the Gutrend back several notches, have you? Well, this is wonderful news.

Whimnia will want to hear this as well. Please let her know.
[ES] ¿Has bajado a los Gutrends varios escalones? Bueno, ¡esta es una noticia maravillosa!

Whimnia querrá escuchar esto también. Por favor, házselo saber.

[EN] Oh, this is good news.

I'll make a note. I guarantee we'll take advantage of this.
[ES] Oh, esta es una buena noticia.

Tomaré nota. Te garantizo que le sacaremos provecho.
